senses: to be behind, follow after, pursue, persecute, run after
to pursue, put to flight, chase, dog, attend closely upon
to follow after, aim to secure (fig)
(Piel) to pursue ardently, aim eagerly to secure, pursue
(Pual) to be pursued, be chased away

strongs.def: to run after (usually with hostile intent; figuratively (of time) gone by)
strongs.kjv: chase, put to flight, follow (after, on), hunt, (be under) persecute(-ion, -or), pursue(-r)
